messages:
Sam: Heads-up — proposing a soft rollforward for v2 routing next week. Plan: header opt-in + tiny canary sampling + console override. Want minimal surprise for customers. Thoughts?

Priya: +1. We need a telemetry plan up-front: route_pct, fallback_rate, p50/p95 latency, error_rate, and quota_mismatch_count. Also flag to annotate customer when they hit the rolled-forward path.

Miguel: Main worry is quota/billing mapping. v2 tokenization or response framing may change token counts. Routing needs to map usage back to the same customer quota bin. Propose a "compat_quota" mapping in routing table.

Kate: Console/UX question — we should expose: per-customer toggle, global master rollback, per-route sample slider, and a prominent banner when rollforward is on. Also a runbook link in the banner.

Rick: Ops constraints: add a circuit-breaker — if fallback_rate > 5% over 5m or error_rate increases > 200% relative to baseline, auto-step-down sampling to 0.1% and page SRE. Also consider KV cache warmup/eviction when switching model variants — could spike memory.

Priya: snippet for detection I was thinking (pseudo):
```
if (req.headers['x-rw-client-version']?.startsWith('2') || req.headers['x-rw-optin-v2'] == '1') {
  route = 'v2'
} else if (sampled_for_canary(req.client_id, 0.01)) {
  route = 'v2'
} else {
  route = 'v1'
}
```

Sam: I prefer a single explicit header `x-rw-target-version` for clarity. If present route there; fallback to sampled canary; otherwise v1. Avoid magic version parsing.

Miguel: For model incompatibilities: detect signature mismatch early. Behavior options: `reject` (hard fail), `shim-convert` (attempt conversion), or `fallback` (route back to v1). For authentication/structured APIs I vote for `reject` by default. For plain text gen we can fallback.

Leah: Product side — we must keep migration notices visible (console, emails for large customers). Deprecation policy still 30-day notice for mandatory changes; this rollforward is opt-in so no forced migration.

Kate: UX details for console toggle: name it `rollforward.v2` with states: Off / Canary (slider 0.01%–5%) / On. Show historical routing_pct and fallback_rate right next to the control. Add a quick "revert" button that sets slider to 0 and records the action.

Miguel: Also add a per-route annotation in the routing logs: `route_decision: header|sample|default` so telemetry can segment.

Rick: Agree. We'll need dashboards: 1) global route_pct over time, 2) per-customer route_pct and fallback_rate, 3) top 10 customers by mismatch_count, 4) latency delta (v2 - v1) p50/p95.

Sam: Ops question — if we do `compat_quota` mapping, who owns that table? Product or Billing? Miguel?

Miguel: Billing must own the final mapping, but routing service should accept a mapping blob (json) per-customer to look up token equivalence. We'll provide defaults until billing-provided mapping exists.

Priya: Telemetry event proposal: `rollforward.evaluate` with tags: customer_id, route_decision, fallback_reason (if any), token_adjustment_factor, latency_ms, model_version. That will let us compute accurate cost impact.

DeployBot: config pushed to staging: `routing.policy=soft-rollforward;target=v2;sampling=0.01;header=x-rw-target-version` — rolling out to 5% of staging traffic for tests.

Ops-Bot: ALERT (staging): fallback_rate > 5% (30s window) for route=service-x. See /ops/incidents/INC-2024-334

Sam: ack. Rolling sample back to 0.1% for staging.

Kate: I'll add the console control + runbook link. UX will show live preview of metrics and a "take action" dropdown (revert, pause, notify-customer).

Rick: Reminder: add automation to auto-reduce sample and tag the rollout if fallback > threshold. Manual override required to re-enable.

Priya: Also add a sampling experiment id to events so we can slice A/B analysis.

Leah: Could we add a gentle telemetry banner for customers who hit v2: "You are currently opted into the v2 rollforward. Expect slightly different token counts; contact support if you see issues."

Miguel: Implementation note: when routing to v2 for a customer with no `compat_quota`, we should conservatively attribute to v1 pricing until mapping confirmed to avoid underbilling.

Sam: Good call. Any blockers? If not I'll open a brief RFC and schedule the rollout next Tuesday (staging -> canary -> prod).

Kate: No blockers from UX. Will deliver toggle + metrics panel Wednesday EOD.

Rick: SRE will add circuit-breaker + dashboards by Friday.

Priya: I'll own telemetry schema and event names.

Miguel: I'll coordinate with Billing for mapping handoff.

Leah: Product approves. Please include customer comms draft in RFC.

Sam: Thanks all. Filing RFC now: RFC-2024-ROLLFORWARD-03. :thumbsup:
